corrections.name: btagPNetQvG_SF
corrections.description: ParticleNet QvG shape scale factors for AK4 jets, 2022 postEE (Run 3). Derived via 2×2 tag-and-probe: Z+jets (quark-enriched) + dijet (gluon-enriched). Dijet data uses per-pT-bin triggers: ZeroBias [30,40), DJ40 [40,60), DJ60 [60,80), DJ80 [80,140), DJ140 [140,200), DJ200 [200,260), DJ260 [260,∞) GeV. pT bins: [30,40,50,60,80,140,200,260,8000] GeV. |η| bins: [0,1.3,2.5,3.0,4.7] (SF=1 for |η|≥3.0). Score bins [0,0.20) and [0.70,1.0) merged in forward region.
